issuer: the Minnesota Department of Public Safety, Driver and Vehicle Services (DVS)
note: The DVS fee page (read 2026-10-30) gives a Class D licence at $46 and an ID card under 65 at $35.50. The renewal page gives standard licences and ID cards, 21 and older, four years (under 21, to the 21st birthday). DVS has a page for new drivers 18 and older, who get a Class D licence without the provisional phase that new drivers under 18 go through, so a full licence is kept from 18 (a provisional licence holder may move up earlier, under Minnesota Statutes 171.055, which isn't held). An ID card is issued under 16 too (valid to the 21st birthday), so the card has no age. Not held: the provisional licence, the under-21 terms, enhanced cards, the 65-and-older card.
